summary: Recorded a learning that the te9_dev source tables (bookmarks, bookmark_content, bookmark_analysis) are read-only mirrors populated by an external Raindrop sync that does NOT live in this repo — so grepping for sync code will find nothing. Includes live-DB evidence (sync ran 2026-08-06, 2,446 rows) and the related gotcha that the homepage "2,270" count is hardcoded in +page.svelte:141.

user: Homepage now shows the real, live bookmark count instead of a stale hardcoded number
what: The hero on the homepage now reads "Semantic search over N bookmarks" where N is fetched live from the database (SELECT count(*) FROM te9_dev.bookmarks) via a new +page.server.ts load function, replacing the old hardcoded "2,270" string.
why: The count now stays accurate automatically as the corpus grows. Previously it had drifted to show 2,270 while the DB actually held 2,446, so the number was visibly wrong.
next: Visit the homepage — the count updates itself as new bookmarks are synced.

summary: Recorded a MAJOR design ADR that supersedes the agentos-sdk.dev warm-paper system: the app now follows an "instrument-grade precision tool" direction (OKLCH tokens, Hanken Grotesk + Martian Mono, live instrument readout, dropped chrome-gradient), driven by the .impeccable.md brief. Added a companion rule capturing the 5 instrument-grade design principles + banned tells for all future UI work.

user: Search tool redesigned into a calm, data-forward "instrument" with a live corpus / last-indexed / latency readout
what: Home + results page restyled to an instrument-grade light theme (Hanken Grotesk + Martian Mono): a live status readout showing corpus size, last-indexed time, and query latency at the top; lowercase mono mode pills; a hero search field with a gold focus-signal caret; numbered result rows that fly in; and a clear danger-tinted error state.
why: Makes the tool feel trustworthy and precise — you see live corpus/latency state at a glance, and the calmer legible palette speeds up quick mid-task lookups.
next: Open the home page and run a search to see the new readout and result styling.

user: Search field no longer shows a green ring when you click into it
what: Removed the global green focus-visible ring from input fields so clicking into the search box shows only its gold underline and caret.
why: The green ring was visually noisy and duplicated the focus cue the gold underline already provides.
next: Click into the search box at http://localhost:4317 to see the cleaner focus state.

summary: Added Concept page 'URL-driven search state' documenting the ?q=…&mode=ask contract in src/routes/+page.svelte: debounced replaceState while typing, push on submit, synced-guard $effect for external navigation, and that +page.server.ts deliberately doesn't read the params.

user: Searches are now shareable — the URL shows your query and mode, so you can bookmark, share, and step back/forward through searches
what: The search input state moved into URL params (?q=…&mode=ask): typing updates the URL live, submitting adds a history entry, and opening a shared link re-runs the search
why: You can send someone a link to your exact search (including Ask mode), reload or bookmark a search without losing it, and use browser back/forward to revisit previous searches
next: Copy the URL after any search to share it, or press back to step through your recent searches.
